event: Probably matches on generic "intr_count". Check for the specific incr registers in C tests.
Those are mask entries for register reset/access tests, not checks of pulse behavior.

I submitted the verdict as verified: all five items stand as untested.

I searched the whole repository for `count_incr` and `INTR_COUNT_INCR`. Outside the RTL and RDL, the only hits were:
- coverage points in `src/mci/coverage/mci_top_cov_if.sv`
- a covergroup generator script
- the generated address-map headers
- mask entries in `src/integration/test_suites/libs/mci/mci.c`

None of these stimulates an interrupt event and then checks the pulse or counter, so none could fail on wrong behavior. The coverpoints only sample the field value. The mask entries in `mci.c` are register-access exclusions, not behavior checks.

My searches for the five behaviors individually (rising-edge increment, decrement by 1, pulse mirrors the event, 1-bit down-counter, 1-clock-cycle pulse) turned up no test or assertion in the C tests, SV tests or assertion files.

The first submission attempt was rejected because I had recorded only one search for five items. The second, with a search recorded per item, was accepted.
